license: Janus curation, Apache-2.0; field labels quoted from official public forms (see notes)

fields_status.verified: read in the official form or page
fields_status.derived: read from an official machine-readable file (form JSON); the rendered form was not filled in
fields_status.partial: only part of the form was read, or the labels come from another edition (field_source)
fields_status.unverified: not confirmed; Janus shows no field mapping for it
fields_status.none: a contact channel (e-mail, phone, directory) with no form

note: Official channels for reporting a suspected side effect of a medicine (report-assistant spec). Only official sites were used. Field labels are the short labels as published, with the section of the form before ' > '. No MedDRA term is stored (report-assistant DP3). Nothing is fetched at runtime; the app ships apps/web/src/report/channels.json generated from this file.
